title: Flying Nimbus!! PQ 2 reward-domain classification audit

evidence.source: Xenoverse Wiki — PQ 02 A Deal?! The Saiyan Brothers
evidence.finding: PQ 2 basic rewards list Flying Nimbus!!, Goku's Damaged Turtle Hermit Gi, and Spirit Slash; Flying Nimbus!! is therefore a reward item, not a Super Soul.

evidence.source: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Guide and Walkthrough — GameFAQs
evidence.finding: The guide identifies PQ reward categories and independently supports the game's PQ 2 reward inventory.

canonical_state.super_soul_record: acquisition metadata cleared and endpoint retained only as unresolved historical catalogue data

rule: Canonical reward domain is determined by the item's actual in-game/catalogue classification; a stale Super Soul endpoint must not override canonical reward typing.
